en: Colorized interior scene of a large institutional room filled with rows of young women or girls in traditional Dutch-style uniforms and white caps, each seated at wooden desks with laundry items or baskets in front of them. A woman at the front appears to be instructing or supervising. Large windows line the back wall and several hanging ceiling lamps are visible. Red printed text at the lower left identifies the location as Rotterdam and refers to a laundry room in a civic institution.
